summary: Update receptor on an execution node after control plane updates: check receptor --version, run sudo dnf update ansible-runner receptor -y (or dnf update and reboot for all packages), verify the version, restart with sudo systemctl restart receptor and confirm it reconnects.
questions: How do I upgrade receptor on an execution node?
Should I update receptor before or after the control plane?
How do I check the receptor version?

answer_card.title: Upgrade receptor on an execution node
answer_card.answer_md:
Do this after control plane updates:

```
receptor --version
sudo dnf update ansible-runner receptor -y
receptor --version
sudo systemctl restart receptor
```

Then confirm the node is connected to controller or its peers. To update all packages, run `dnf update` and `reboot`.
